title: The Hidden Reality of Buying Cash Flow
hook_text: SOME PEOPLE NEVER START A BUSINESS

beats.say: Some people never start a business. They buy one that already pays.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary silhouette standing on a wet concrete rooftop under heavy blue hour fog.

beats.say: How do you skip years of building from zero and acquire a running cash flow?
beats.visual: Low angle closeup of heavy iron keys sliding across a scratched dark wooden tabletop.

beats.say: Most buyers assume you need massive personal wealth to buy an established company.
beats.visual: Cinematic shot of a lone car driving down a damp empty highway at night under sodium lights.

beats.say: That is false. Many use other people's money and seller financing to fund the purchase.
beats.visual: Extreme close up of rain drops hitting a cold window pane with city lights blurred in the background.

beats.say: Here is the exact framework to evaluate your target. Step one, check the historical cash flow.
beats.visual: High angle shot of a solitary person walking past towering concrete pillars in deep shadow.

beats.say: Step two, verify the debt coverage ratio before you sign any agreements.
beats.visual: Close up of a heavy brass door handle reflecting a dim hallway light.

beats.say: Step three, structure the deal so the business pays its own debt down over time.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a massive steel bridge cutting through thick evening mist.

beats.say: What is the honest catch no one talks about?
beats.visual: Cinematic shot of dark stormy ocean waves crashing hard against a jagged stone cliff.

beats.say: The debt is owed in bad years too. Lenders demand personal guarantees regardless of market drops.
beats.visual: Single practical light casting harsh shadows across an empty industrial warehouse floor.

beats.say: You acquire existing cash flow by using borrowed capital, but you carry the full risk when revenue dips.
beats.visual: Low angle silhouette of a person standing on an overpass looking at distant traffic lights.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a vast horizon at dusk with the last strip of gold light fading out.

caption: Some buyers skip the startup phase entirely. Here is the reality of buying cash flow. #money #personalfinance #business #wealth #finance
description: Learn how buying an existing cash-flowing business works using other people's money, and understand the brutal debt risk when bad years hit.
